summary: Completed phases 18-21 of 26 (waves 7-8), resuming from a continuation handoff at 17/26 with phase 18 at 4/5 checklist items done and committed as 'phase 18.1'. Finished phase 18 by adding a logos semantic-package round-trip test to builder/tests/unit/test_serialize.py. Phase 19 folded the operator-free relevance subtheory into constitutive (20 examples absorbed, docs relocated to constitutive/RELEVANCE.md, all call sites updated, subtheory-conformance xfail removed). Phase 20 collapsed bimodal's dual class identity: moved the flat 3194-line semantic.py into semantic/core.py verbatim and deleted the importlib dynamic-loader shim that used to execute it a second time under a synthetic module name (bimodal_semantic_module) purely to keep --maximize pickling working; discovered and fixed a real downstream regression this exposed (witness_registry.py/witness_constraints.py's own 3-dot relative import to theory_lib/errors.py broke scaffolded bimodal projects, switched to absolute imports) plus an unrelated pre-existing PackageError arg-count bug in builder/strategies.py that was masking the real exception. Phase 21 split the now-single-identity semantic/core.py into the canonical core.py/model.py/proposition.py file set matching imposition/exclusion/logos, added bimodal/tests/conftest.py, and removed bimodal's remaining SEMANTIC_PACKAGE_XFAIL_REASON entry. All four in-tree theories (bimodal, exclusion, imposition, logos) are now uniformly normalized onto the semantic/ package contract with a single class identity each. Full sanity sweep (theory_lib/ + layering + builder, 1303 tests) shows exactly the 7 already-documented pre-existing failures and zero new regressions.

blockers.description: Phase 2's full serial oracle suite run (550 tests) remains unattempted since the phases-1-9 dispatch -- collection count (550) and the 5 xfail(strict=True) line locations remain pinned and verified clean via verify-refactor.sh after every phase this dispatch. A future session with pytest-xdist available, or dedicated/isolated resources, should re-attempt the full oracle run and commit baselines/oracle-run.txt + baselines/junit-oracle.xml to fully close Phase 2 (still marked [PARTIAL] in the plan).

Phase 22 (Restore bimodal iterate.py and Unify the Test Layout) is the next phase and is a meaningfully-sized, git-archaeology-heavy unit of work: restoring a 611-line file via `git show 9b76ffa2^:...iterate.py`, porting it to the current iterate_example_generator convention using imposition/iterate.py as a template, verifying multiple hasattr-guarded attribute references, writing a fresh test_iterate.py (explicitly NOT restoring the old Mock-heavy 156-line version), reconciling bimodal/docs/ITERATE.md, deleting bimodal/tests/e2e/, and extending code/tests/e2e/test_project_creation.py's theory parametrization. Recommended: begin Phase 22 with a fresh dispatch rather than continuing with reduced context budget.

decisions_made: logos's semantic/serialize round-trip is now asserted by a dedicated test rather than assumed: builder/serialize.py rehydrates via importlib on the recorded __module__, and the new '...logos.semantic.core' value is confirmed importable
The former relevance subtheory's examples keep their REL_ prefix inside constitutive/examples.py for provenance; the same 4-of-20 active example_range subset was preserved exactly

Relevance's boilerplate notebooks/template.json and notebooks/README.md were not carried over verbatim (superseded by constitutive's near-identical equivalents, referenced nowhere in code); only the substantive RELEVANCE.md and the interactive notebook itself were preserved

Bimodal's witness_registry.py/witness_constraints.py use ABSOLUTE imports (from model_checker.theory_lib.errors import ...) for the shared errors.py dependency, diverging from exclusion/imposition's 3-dot relative form -- deliberate, because bimodal's witness files are exercised by scaffolded-project builder tests (via BuildProject()'s buggy bare-default-to-bimodal registry ordering) and exclusion/imposition's aren't, so only bimodal's version needed to survive being copied a directory level shallower than its theory_lib home

Exclusion and imposition were confirmed (by direct reproduction) to have an identical, equally-latent scaffolded-project relative-import depth defect via their own '...errors'/'...logos.semantic' imports -- deliberately left untouched since it predates this task and is not introduced or worsened by it

bimodal/semantic/core.py (3192 lines) had exactly 3 top-level classes and zero module-level helper functions, so both the phase-20 move and the phase-21 split were clean, unambiguous cuts with no shared-helper threading needed

Phase 21's oracle-suite verification task was scoped to 279/550 tests (every oracle/bimodal_logic/ file that directly exercises BimodalSemantics/BimodalProposition/BimodalStructure construction and comparison), matching Phase 2's already-accepted sandbox constraint (no pytest-xdist, resource contention) rather than attempting the full serial run
dead_ends: Do not assume witness_registry.py/witness_constraints.py's existing '...errors' relative imports are safe to leave untouched when normalizing a theory's semantic/__init__.py from a dynamic-loader shim to a plain re-export -- the OLD dynamic loader executed the flat semantic.py directly via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, bypassing the package's normal import machinery entirely, so witness_registry.py/witness_constraints.py's own relative imports were NEVER actually exercised as package submodules in a scaffolded project. Only the real theory_lib nesting depth (4 levels) was ever tested by any prior test; a plain re-export __init__.py exercises the normal 2-level-shallower scaffolded-project import chain for the first time and can surface a previously-dormant depth mismatch

PackageImportError(...) in builder/strategies.py's exec-fallback exception handler was being called with 4 positional arguments against PackageError's 3-argument (message, context, suggestion) constructor -- always a live TypeError bug, but silent until something actually exercises that specific fallback path (which the phase-20 witness-import regression did, incidentally surfacing it)
